verdict.rationale: Flagright documents dedicated batch API endpoints: POST /batch/consumer/users and POST /batch/business/users. Responses report `successful` and `failed` counts plus `failedRecords`, and a batch get-business-users endpoint is also documented, so programmatic bulk processing of many items in one call is a first-party capability. missing for 10: evidence of bulk operations beyond user creation and retrieval (e.g. batch transactions, bulk case or alert status updates), and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior and limits.
